scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:check-ports && docker compose --env-file .env.docker build
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:check-ports && docker compose --env-file .env.docker up -d --build
scripts.docker:dev:build: npm run docker:check-ports && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:dev:up: npm run docker:check-ports && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.docker:dev:rebuild:api: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build api
scripts.docker:prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec api npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:prod:seed: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec api npm run seed -w @hathanh/api
